import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { oauthApplications } from "../../../backend/schema/oauth_applications";

export const oauthApplicationsCms = customizeTable<typeof oauthApplications>("oauth_applications", {
    display: {
        title: "uid"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "name", "ownerType", "uid", "secret", "scopes"],
    fields: {
        ownerType: {
            multiline: true
        },
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        uid: {
            multiline: true
        },
        secret: {
            multiline: true
        },
        scopes: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "name",
        "ownerType",
        "uid",
        "secret",
        "scopes",
        "confidential",
        "owner",
        "redirectUri",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
